g.title: TasksAndContainerPoolCoarse
g.text: Tasks and Container Pool — coarse task/container state machine
wire: task webhook (container-task-webhook GET claim · POST actions) + container events (container-events task.started · task.done · container.idle) + container HTTP (/wakeup · /detach)
edges: solid = call/HTTP · dotted = DB read · dashed = postWebhook (fire-and-forget) · constraint=false = back edge
